items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: we would leave Shorty Baker in St. Louis.

ctx.x: Yeah, '51. But any way, this is -- this was a great band, it was a great show, and as I said I could hardly wait to get to work every night because it was fireworks. Of course somebody was missing out of the band every night, you know, we'd leave -- we would leave Shorty Baker in St. Louis. I think his home was in St. Louis. If we passed through another town, another one would disappear. Willie Smith always got on the bandstand last. I think he was superstitious. He would wait until everyone had got on
that -- had got on the bandstand, then he would get on. It was a superstition. He was a very superstitious man, you know.
